headings.description: Used for the large kinetic hero, manifesto numbers, and project titles. Brings an elegant, editorial, high-end print magazine feel to the architecture portfolio.

body.description: Highly readable, geometric yet approachable sans-serif for project descriptions, metadata, and the manifesto text. Provides stark contrast to the serif headings.

accents.description: Used sparingly for project metadata (Year, Location, Role) and the mailto links to emphasize the 'technical/blueprint' aspect of architecture.

rules: NO Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk allowed.
Headings (H1) max clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem). Implement tracking-tighter for impact.
Use ALL CAPS with tracking-[0.2em] for overlines and structural labels (e.g., 'PROJECT 01', 'LOCATION').

background.description: Warm off-white paper/oat tones. Simulates high-quality architectural print paper.

text.description: Ink black for primary text to ensure striking contrast. Slate/charcoal for secondary text.

accent.description: A sharp 'Drafting Red' or 'Safety Orange-Red'. Use exceptionally sparingly (e.g., a single dot, hover line, or active state) to break the warmth.

hero.description: Full-height (min-h-screen) layout. Large typographic name 'VINAYAK AWATI' with masked line-by-line reveal on load. A subtle parallax hero moment with an architectural image (or texture). Include a slow editorial marquee ('Architecture | Photography | Experiments | Creative Work') at the bottom of the fold.

about_manifesto.description: Editorial 2-column or asymmetrical layout. Large serif numbers ('01', '02') paired with the manifesto ('Good architecture is like good coffee...'). Generous spacing (py-32). Education and Skills presented in a crisp, tabular, grid-aligned format.

projects_gallery.description: No detail pages. A vertical or horizontal scroll-through gallery. Large edge-to-edge or generously padded imagery. Use sticky project titles or metadata as the images scroll past. Immersive, museum-like spacing.

footer.description: Massive typographic 'LET'S TALK' or email address. No contact form. mailto link and social links (Instagram @vinayaaaaaak_ & @vinayak.jpeg_) styled as clean text links with an underline hover animation.

grids.spacing_scale: Use generous tailwind spacing: gap-16, gap-24, py-32, py-40.
grids.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Use 12-column CSS grids but intentionally leave columns empty (e.g., col-span-5 col-start-2) to create negative space and tension.

motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis MUST be implemented for smooth scrolling to give the site premium momentum and weight.
motion.on_load: Framer Motion line-by-line text reveal (using clip-path or overflow-hidden wrapper with y-axis translation).
motion.scroll_reveals: Images should reveal with a subtle scale-down and opacity fade on scroll. Text blocks should fade in gently.
motion.parallax: Hero image or gallery images should have a slight parallax effect (y-axis translation tied to scroll) to create depth.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a very subtle SVG noise/grain overlay (opacity-20 or less) across the entire body to reinforce the 'print/paper' tactile feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px borders (#121212 at 10% opacity) to separate sections or create a strict architectural grid for the skills/experience section.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow speed (speed={30}). Serif font, uppercase, separated by distinct dots or stars.

media.image_treatment: No rounded corners on images (sharp edges only) to reflect architectural precision. Minimal overlays unless text must sit on top, then use black/20% gradient.
media.aspect_ratios: Mix landscape (16:9), portrait (3:4), and square (1:1) within the gallery to create an editorial rhythm.

hero_texture.description: Architectural blueprint, used as a subtle background or hero parallax layer.

project_after.description: AFTER: IT workspace, Mangaluru. Modern office interior.

project_edam.description: EDAM: Contemporary weekend residence, Belgaum. Small black contemporary house.

project_antara.description: ANTARA: Contemporary library, Ahmedabad. Modern library with glass ceiling.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'framer-motion' for scroll reveals and kinetic typography.
Install 'react-fast-marquee' for the slow editorial marquee.
Use plain Tailwind CSS + HTML structure for the marketing layout, avoiding generic Shadcn cards to keep the design fluid and editorial.
Inject the Google Fonts 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' into the main index.css or index.html.
Implement the 'masked line-by-line reveal': wrap text lines in an overflow-hidden span and translate Y from 100% to 0% using framer-motion.
Make sure images in the scroll-through gallery are large and impactful, avoiding cramped grid cells. Use max-width containers smartly.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use negative space aggressively (p-16, p-24) to create tension.
Ensure dark colors are not used as simplistic gradients. Solid, architectural colors only.
Create depth through scale contrast (massive serif typography next to tiny mono labels).
NEVER use generic centered layouts globally. Align left for text blocks, align right for project metadata, creating an asymmetrical editorial layout.
All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-mailto-link').
Micro-animations are required on all hovers (e.g., links should have a sliding underline or color shift).
No placeholder URLs allowed; only use the provided image_urls.
